TC-2 · REQ-2: safety stock is 20 percent of lead-time demand · lead-time demand 300 → safety stock 60
TC-3 · REQ-3: reorder point is lead-time demand plus safety stock · lead-time demand 300, safety stock 60 → reorder point 360
TC-4 · REQ-3: reorder point equals 1.2 times lead-time demand · lead-time demand 300 → reorder point 360
TC-5 · REQ-4 and AC-2: recommend a reorder when stock on hand is at the reorder point · reorder point 360, stock on hand 360 → recommend a reorder
TC-6 · REQ-4 and AC-3: do not recommend a reorder when stock on hand is above the reorder point · reorder point 360, stock on hand 361 → do not recommend a reorder
